words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for bond and preferred stock

examples.en: Her retirement plan splits savings between a bond and preferred stock fund.
examples.zh: 她的退休计划把储蓄分投于「债券和优先股基金」。

examples.en: Income from the bond and preferred stock fund arrives every quarter.
examples.zh: 「债券和优先股基金」的收益每个季度到账。

collocations: arrange the bond and preferred stock fund
monitor the bond and preferred stock fund
repay the bond and preferred stock fund

words.zhGloss: 付息日之间公司债券的估价
words.enDefinition: valuation of a bond between interest payment dates
acceptedZhAnswers: 付息日之间公司债券的估价

examples.en: Bond valuation between interest dates adds accrued interest to the clean price.
examples.zh: 「付息日之间公司债券的估价」等于除息价格加上应计利息。

examples.en: The settlement figure came from bond valuation between interest dates, coupons being quarterly.
examples.zh: 由于按季付息，结算价由「付息日之间公司债券的估价」得出。

collocations: calculate the bond valuation between interest dates
compare the bond valuation between interest dates
interpret the bond valuation between interest dates

words.enDefinition: a receipt acknowledging payment of the price for newly subscribed shares

examples.en: The registrar issued a receipt for the subscription price the same afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，登记处就开出了「认购价款收据」。

examples.en: Attach the receipt for the subscription price to your allotment letter.
examples.zh: 请把「认购价款收据」附在配股通知书的后面。

collocations: underwrite the receipt for the subscription price
syndicate the receipt for the subscription price
refinance the receipt for the subscription price

words.enDefinition: a central bank concerning central banks

examples.en: Delegates call the Basel club the central bank of central banks.
examples.zh: 与会代表把巴塞尔的这家机构称作「中央银行的中央银行」。

examples.en: The central bank of central banks settles gold swaps between its members.
examples.zh: 这家「中央银行的中央银行」为会员办理黄金掉期的清算。

collocations: open an account at the central bank of central banks
deal with the central bank of central banks
audit the central bank of central banks

words.enDefinition: a corporation engaged in overseas chinese commercial banking

examples.en: She wired her tuition through the Overseas Chinese Commercial Banking Corporation.
examples.zh: 她通过「华侨商业银行」汇出了学费。

examples.en: Remittance slips from the Overseas Chinese Commercial Banking Corporation fill the family album.
examples.zh: 家里的相册贴满了「华侨商业银行」的汇款单据。

collocations: calculate the overseas chinese commercial banking corporation
compare the overseas chinese commercial banking corporation
interpret the overseas chinese commercial banking corporation

words.zhGloss: 资本支出对销售的比率
words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates capital expenditure to sales
acceptedZhAnswers: 资本支出对销售的比率

examples.en: A capital expenditure to sales ratio of nine percent signals aggressive expansion.
examples.zh: 「资本支出对销售的比率」达到9%，表明扩张力度很大。

examples.en: Analysts track the capital expenditure to sales ratio across the retailer group.
examples.zh: 分析师跟踪这家零售集团各业务的「资本支出对销售的比率」。

collocations: calculate the capital expenditure to sales ratio
compare the capital expenditure to sales ratio
interpret the capital expenditure to sales ratio

words.enDefinition: expenditures on capital expenditures and revenue

examples.en: Accountants separate capital expenditures and revenue expenditures on every invoice.
examples.zh: 会计对每张发票都区分「资本支出与收益支出」。

examples.en: Rewiring the shop raises the classic split between capital expenditures and revenue expenditures.
examples.zh: 给店铺重铺电线，正涉及「资本支出与收益支出」如何划分的经典问题。

words.enDefinition: money available or allocated for cash deposits in sinking

examples.en: The trustee places cash deposits in sinking funds only at insured banks.
examples.zh: 受托人只在有存款保险的银行存放「偿债基金银行存款」。

examples.en: Interest earned on cash deposits in sinking funds shortens the repayment schedule.
examples.zh: 「偿债基金银行存款」所生的利息，缩短了偿债时间表。

collocations: arrange the cash deposits in sinking funds
monitor the cash deposits in sinking funds
repay the cash deposits in sinking funds

words.enDefinition: investments held or made in relation to pay-off method for capital

examples.en: The pay-off method for capital investments says the lathe repays itself in four years.
examples.zh: 按「资本投资回收年数法」计算，这台车床四年即可收回投资。

examples.en: Small firms favor the pay-off method for capital investments for its simplicity.
examples.zh: 小企业偏爱「资本投资回收年数法」，因为它的算法简单。

collocations: arrange the pay-off method for capital investments
monitor the pay-off method for capital investments
repay the pay-off method for capital investments

words.enDefinition: investing for formula

examples.en: Formula investing buys more shares whenever the index dips below average.
examples.zh: 「公式投资」会在指数跌破均值时自动加仓。

examples.en: He trusts formula investing because it removes emotion from the trades.
examples.zh: 他相信「公式投资」，因为它把情绪从交易中剔除了。

words.enDefinition: a short-term bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: The ladder mixes short-term bond rungs with a few long maturities.
examples.zh: 这套阶梯组合把「短期债券」与少量长期券搭配在一起。

examples.en: A short-term bond fund barely moves when rates jump a quarter point.
examples.zh: 利率跳升25个基点时，「短期债券」基金几乎没有波动。

words.enDefinition: increases in value arising from short-term capital

examples.en: Selling within months triggered short-term capital gains taxed at ordinary rates.
examples.zh: 几个月内就卖出，收益按「短期资本利得」以普通税率征税。

examples.en: Her short-term capital gains from the day trades dwarfed her salary.
examples.zh: 她日内交易产生的「短期资本利得」远超工资收入。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with short-term

examples.en: Short-term capital flees emerging markets at the first hint of trouble.
examples.zh: 一有风吹草动，「短期资本」就会撤离新兴市场。

examples.en: Central banks build reserves to absorb surges of short-term capital.
examples.zh: 央行储备外汇，以吸收「短期资本」的汹涌流入。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by short-term

examples.en: A short-term loan bridged the gap until the buyer's check cleared.
examples.zh: 在买方支票兑付之前，一笔「短期贷款」帮公司渡过了缺口。

examples.en: The cooperative offers a short-term loan of up to ninety days.
examples.zh: 合作社提供最长九十天的「短期贷款」。

words.enDefinition: investments expected to be converted to cash within one year

examples.en: The clinic parks this quarter's surplus in short-term investments until renovations begin.
examples.zh: 诊所把本季度的结余放进「短期投资」，等翻修开工。

examples.en: Short-term investments on the balance sheet mature within twelve months.
examples.zh: 资产负债表上的「短期投资」一年之内到期。

words.enDefinition: cross-border flows of short-term capital and liquid investments

examples.en: Sharp short-term capital movements forced the currency peg to break in August.
examples.zh: 八月，剧烈的「短期资本流动」迫使汇率盯住制瓦解。

examples.en: Economists chart short-term capital movements against the interest differentials each month.
examples.zh: 经济学家每月把「短期资本流动」与利差对照作图。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from follow-up

examples.en: The angels approved a follow-up investment after the pilot batch sold out.
examples.zh: 试销批次售罄之后，天使投资人批准了「后续投资」。

examples.en: Without a follow-up investment, the factory expansion stalls at the pilot line.
examples.zh: 若没有「后续投资」，工厂扩建将停在试产线阶段。

words.enDefinition: a market for short-term money

examples.en: Corporate treasuries fund payroll gaps in the short-term money market.
examples.zh: 公司资金部在「短期货币市场」调剂发工资前的头寸。

examples.en: Rates in the short-term money market ticked up ahead of the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期临近，「短期货币市场」的利率小幅走高。

collocations: clear goods through the short-term money market

words.enDefinition: a short-term rate of interest used in professional practice

examples.en: The short-term rate of interest spiked a day before the policy meeting.
examples.zh: 政策会议前一天，「短期利率」一度飙升。

examples.en: Our overdraft pricing follows the short-term rate of interest published each Monday.
examples.zh: 我们的透支定价跟随每周一公布的「短期利率」。

collocations: calculate the short-term rate of interest
compare the short-term rate of interest
interpret the short-term rate of interest

words.enDefinition: the price charged in forward transactions

examples.en: The farmer locked the forward price for October wheat back in spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，农户就锁定了十月小麦的「远期价格」。

examples.en: The forward price embeds today's spot plus the cost of carry.
examples.zh: 「远期价格」等于当前现货价加上持有成本。

words.enDefinition: selling produce or securities forward, before delivery, to lock in prices

examples.en: Forward marketing lets the co-op sell next summer's crop before planting.
examples.zh: 借助「远期销售」，合作社在播种之前就卖出了明夏的收成。

examples.en: Their forward marketing program smooths cash flow across the harvest season.
examples.zh: 「远期销售」计划让收获季的现金流更平稳。

words.enDefinition: a market in which forward contracts are agreed for future delivery at a price set today, typically OTC

examples.en: The forward market for jet fuel keeps airline budgets calm.
examples.zh: 航油的「远期市场」让航空公司的预算保持平稳。

examples.en: Prices in the forward market sit above spot during storage shortages.
examples.zh: 仓储紧张时，「远期市场」的价格会高于现货。

words.enDefinition: the market for forward foreign-exchange contracts that lock in an exchange rate for a future date

examples.en: Importers hedge their dollar exposure in the forward exchange market.
examples.zh: 进口商在「远期外汇市场」对冲美元敞口。

examples.en: The forward exchange market prices next quarter's rate at a small premium.
examples.zh: 「远期外汇市场」对下季度的汇率给出了小幅升水的定价。

words.enDefinition: contracts locking in an exchange rate for a future currency settlement

examples.en: We signed forward exchange contracts to fix the dollar cost of the equipment.
examples.zh: 我们签订「远期外汇合约」，把设备的美元成本锁定下来。

examples.en: Forward exchange contracts fix the rate today and settle the cash in June.
examples.zh: 「远期外汇合约」今天敲定汇率，六月交割资金。

words.enDefinition: law governing small loan

examples.en: The state small loan law caps interest at thirty-six percent annually.
examples.zh: 州「小额贷款法」把年利率上限定为36%。

examples.en: Lenders rewrite their contracts whenever the small loan law changes.
examples.zh: 「小额贷款法」一有修改，放贷机构就得重拟合同。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by back-to-back

examples.en: The two subsidiaries offset currency risk with a back-to-back loan.
examples.zh: 两家子公司用「对销贷款」对冲了货币风险。

examples.en: A back-to-back loan lets each unit borrow at home while funding abroad.
examples.zh: 通过「对销贷款」，各方各在本国借款，同时为对方提供境外资金。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from foreign

examples.en: Foreign investment in the port rose after the customs reform.
examples.zh: 通关改革之后，港口的「国外投资」有所增加。

examples.en: The ministry screens foreign investment in telecoms for security review.
examples.zh: 该部委对电信领域的「国外投资」进行安全审查。

words.enDefinition: an investor characterised as foreign

examples.en: A foreign investor bought the mill and promised to keep every job.
examples.zh: 一位「外国投资者」收购了工厂，并承诺保留全部岗位。

examples.en: The ownership cap for a foreign investor fell from fifty to twenty-five percent.
examples.zh: 「外国投资者」的持股上限从50%降到了25%。

words.enDefinition: a bond issued in a domestic market by a foreign borrower, denominated in that market's currency

examples.en: A foreign bond issued in Tokyo is known as a samurai bond.
examples.zh: 在东京发行的「外国债券」被称为武士债券。

examples.en: The foreign bond pays yen coupons, so the issuer hedged the interest flows.
examples.zh: 这只「外国债券」以日元付息，发行人相应对冲了利息现金流。

words.enDefinition: bills drawn on or by foreign banks

examples.en: The trader discounted the foreign bank bills at the accepting house.
examples.zh: 商人在承兑行贴现了「外国银行票据」。

examples.en: Foreign bank bills from the Swiss houses carry the finest acceptance rates.
examples.zh: 瑞士银行开出的「外国银行票据」，承兑费率最优。

words.enDefinition: an association for foreign credit insurance

examples.en: The Foreign Credit Insurance Association backs exporters selling on open account terms.
examples.zh: 「对外信贷保险协会」为赊销方式的出口提供保障。

examples.en: Members pool loss data through the Foreign Credit Insurance Association each quarter.
examples.zh: 会员每季度通过「对外信贷保险协会」汇集坏账数据。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with foreign

examples.en: Foreign capital rebuilt the storm-damaged harbor within eighteen months of the typhoon.
examples.zh: 台风过后十八个月，「外国资本」重建了受损的海港。

examples.en: The zone courts foreign capital with tax holidays and ready factories.
examples.zh: 开发区以税收减免和现成厂房吸引「外国资本」。

words.enDefinition: a structure of simple capital

examples.en: The firm discloses a simple capital structure of common shares plus retained earnings.
examples.zh: 这家公司披露的「简单资本结构」仅含普通股和留存收益。

examples.en: With a simple capital structure, earnings per share needs no dilution math.
examples.zh: 在「简单资本结构」下，每股收益无需做稀释计算。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by simple

examples.en: A simple loan charging flat interest suits short seasonal needs.
examples.zh: 按单利计息的「简单贷款」，适合短期的季节性需求。

examples.en: Under the simple loan terms, interest never compounds on missed payments.
examples.zh: 按「简单贷款」的条款，逾期款项不计复利。

words.enDefinition: a silver bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: The display case holds silver bond certificates redeemable in coin a century ago.
examples.zh: 展柜里陈列着百年前可兑银币的「银债券」凭证。

examples.en: During the currency chaos, silver bond coupons were paid in coin.
examples.zh: 币制混乱时期，「银债券」的利息以银币支付。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by forced

examples.en: Wartime treasuries raised a forced loan by fixing each merchant's quota.
examples.zh: 战时财政按商家的摊派额度举借「强制贷款」。

examples.en: Nobody applied for it; the forced loan simply appeared on their ledgers.
examples.zh: 没人主动申请，「强制贷款」就这样记上了各家账簿。

words.enDefinition: a journal for foreign exchange purchase

examples.en: Post each dollar drawdown to the foreign exchange purchase journal the same day.
examples.zh: 每笔美元支取都要当天记入「外汇买进日记簿」。

examples.en: The auditor traced the import payments through the foreign exchange purchase journal.
examples.zh: 审计师通过「外汇买进日记簿」逐笔追踪进口付款。

words.enDefinition: a journal for foreign exchange sales

examples.en: Converting sterling into yen goes in the foreign exchange sales journal.
examples.zh: 把英镑换成日元，须记入「外汇卖出日记簿」。

examples.en: Month-end totals from the foreign exchange sales journal feed the ledger.
examples.zh: 「外汇卖出日记簿」的月末合计数据会转入总账。

words.enDefinition: cash set aside in a sinking fund

examples.en: The trustee holds sinking fund cash in a separate bank account.
examples.zh: 受托人把「偿债基金现金」存放在单独的银行账户里。

examples.en: Sinking fund cash accumulates every quarter until the redemption date arrives.
examples.zh: 「偿债基金现金」逐季累积，直到赎回日来临。

words.enDefinition: an instalment for sinking fund

examples.en: Each sinking fund instalment buys back bonds on the open market.
examples.zh: 每笔「偿债基金按期摊还款」都在公开市场购回债券。

examples.en: The company missed a sinking fund instalment and faced a technical default.
examples.zh: 公司漏付了一笔「偿债基金按期摊还款」，面临技术性违约。

words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling sinking fund

examples.en: Under the sinking fund method, the firm sets aside equal yearly amounts.
examples.zh: 按「偿债基金法」，公司每年计提相等的金额。

examples.en: Actuaries apply the sinking fund method when depreciating the ferry fleet.
examples.zh: 精算师用「偿债基金法」对渡轮船队计提折旧。

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to sinking fund

examples.en: The indenture fixes the sinking fund rate at five percent of the debt.
examples.zh: 契约把「偿债基金率」定为债务的5%。

examples.en: A higher sinking fund rate shortens the years until full redemption.
examples.zh: 「偿债基金率」越高，全部赎回所需的年头越短。

words.enDefinition: amounts required to be paid into a sinking fund

examples.en: The sinking fund requirements call for two million into escrow each spring.
examples.zh: 「偿债基金应提额」要求每年春天向托管账户存入两百万元。

examples.en: Skipped sinking fund requirements trigger early maturity under the trust deed.
examples.zh: 未足额提取的「偿债基金应提额」，将按信托契约触发提前到期。

words.enDefinition: an amount set aside for sinking fund

examples.en: The balance sheet shows a sinking fund reserve of six million dollars.
examples.zh: 资产负债表列示了六百万元的「偿债基金准备」。

examples.en: Auditors check the sinking fund reserve against the schedule in the indenture.
examples.zh: 审计师按契约所附时间表核对「偿债基金准备」。

words.enDefinition: a surplus of sinking fund

examples.en: A sinking fund surplus built up after rates fell below the plan.
examples.zh: 利率低于计划水平，「偿债基金盈余」随之积累。

examples.en: Trustees returned the sinking fund surplus to the municipality last June.
examples.zh: 去年六月，受托人把「偿债基金盈余」退还给了市政府。

words.enDefinition: a sinking fund trustee used in professional practice

examples.en: The sinking fund trustee buys bonds wherever they trade cheapest.
examples.zh: 「偿债基金受(信)托人」在哪里买得便宜，就在哪里买债券。

examples.en: We report to the sinking fund trustee quarterly with bank confirmations attached.
examples.zh: 我们每季度向「偿债基金受(信)托人」报送报告，并附上银行询证函。

words.enDefinition: business activity related to foreign exchange

examples.en: The branch earned a third of its fees from foreign exchange business.
examples.zh: 这家分行的手续费收入有三分之一来自「外汇业务」。

examples.en: New compliance rules slowed the bank's foreign exchange business with small importers.
examples.zh: 新的合规要求拖慢了银行面向小进口商的「外汇业务」。

words.zhGloss: 新加坡银行同业拆息率（历史基准）
words.enDefinition: historical Singapore dollar interbank offered rate (SIBOR); last published 31 Dec 2024 and discontinued from 1 Jan 2025, with SGD markets transitioning to SORA
acceptedZhAnswers: 新加坡银行同业拆息率（历史基准）
新加坡银行同业拆息率

examples.en: Mortgages tied to SIBOR switched to SORA after the fixing retired in 2024.
examples.zh: 2024年报价终止后，挂钩「新加坡银行同业拆息率（历史基准）」的按揭改用SORA定价。

examples.en: Regional treasuries once watched each morning's SIBOR fixing for pricing cues.
examples.zh: 区域资金部当年每天早晨紧盯「新加坡银行同业拆息率（历史基准）」的定盘价，寻找定价线索。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for sinking

examples.en: The city retires its arena bonds through a dedicated sinking fund.
examples.zh: 该市通过专门的「偿债基金」来偿还体育馆债券。

examples.en: Each year the sinking fund sweeps in part of the tax receipts.
examples.zh: 「偿债基金」每年都会吸纳一部分税收进账。

words.enDefinition: an accumulation for sinking fund

examples.en: Sinking fund accumulation reached the redemption target two years ahead of plan.
examples.zh: 「偿债基金累计」比计划提前两年达到赎回目标。

examples.en: The chart plots sinking fund accumulation against outstanding principal each year.
examples.zh: 图表逐年对照「偿债基金累计」与未偿本金。

words.enDefinition: an appropriation for sinking fund

examples.en: The council approved a sinking fund appropriation of eight hundred thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 议会批准了一笔八十万元的「偿债基金拨款」。

examples.en: Delays in the sinking fund appropriation pushed the redemption to autumn.
examples.zh: 「偿债基金拨款」的延误把赎回推迟到了秋天。

words.enDefinition: movements of funds or positions related to balance of capital

examples.en: The balance of capital movements turned negative after heavy bond outflows.
examples.zh: 债券资金大量外流之后，「资本流动差额」转为负值。

examples.en: Officials publish the balance of capital movements with a two-month lag.
examples.zh: 官方发布「资本流动差额」数据时滞后两个月。

words.enDefinition: a balanced bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: The balanced bond blends a fixed coupon with a small equity share.
examples.zh: 这种「权衡债券」把固定利息与少量股权成分结合在一起。

examples.en: Investors picked the balanced bond for its mix of safety and upside.
examples.zh: 「权衡债券」兼顾安全与上行空间，投资者因此选择了它。

words.enDefinition: fidelity/crime cover against losses from forgery or fraudulent alteration of instruments

examples.en: The bank claimed on its forgery bond after the altered draft surfaced.
examples.zh: 被篡改的汇票曝光之后，银行就「防伪造保险」提出了索赔。

examples.en: Forgery bond cover extends to fraudulent endorsements on customer checks.
examples.zh: 「防伪造保险」的保障范围包括客户支票上的伪造背书。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by signature

examples.en: The credit union granted a signature loan on his word alone.
examples.zh: 信用合作社仅凭他的一句承诺，发放了「无担保贷款」。

examples.en: A signature loan of two thousand dollars covered the dentist's deposit.
examples.zh: 两千元的「无担保贷款」付清了牙医的定金。

words.enDefinition: protection against loss related to bailee's customers'

examples.en: The dry cleaner carries bailee's customers' insurance for garments left overnight.
examples.zh: 干洗店为过夜保管的衣物投保了「受托人代客保险」。

examples.en: Bailee's customers' insurance paid the tailor when the storage room flooded.
examples.zh: 储物间被淹之后，「受托人代客保险」赔付了这家裁缝店。

words.enDefinition: foreign transfer of shares used in professional practice

examples.en: The foreign transfer of shares needed central bank approval under the decree.
examples.zh: 依据法令，「国外股票转移」须经央行批准。

examples.en: Settlement of the foreign transfer of shares took three weeks through the offshore registry.
examples.zh: 这笔「国外股票转移」经离岸登记处办理，耗时三周。

words.enDefinition: a baby bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: Grandpa bought baby bonds of fifty dollars each during the war.
examples.zh: 战争年代，祖父买的是每张五十元的「小额债券」。

examples.en: Baby bonds let small savers join in the railway financing.
examples.zh: 「小额债券」让小额储户也能参与铁路融资。

words.enDefinition: the balance of funds held at the bank

examples.en: The balance at the bank covers exactly one month of wages.
examples.zh: 「银行结余」刚好够发一个月的工资。

examples.en: Her balance at the bank grew once the side business took off.
examples.zh: 副业起步之后，她的「银行结余」渐渐多了起来。

collocations: engage the balance at the bank
bank with the balance at the bank
instruct the balance at the bank

words.enDefinition: an association concerning banks

examples.en: The Association of Banks publishes daily clearing figures for its members.
examples.zh: 「银行公会」每天向会员发布票据清算数据。

examples.en: Lobbyists from the Association of Banks met the finance minister on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二，「银行公会」的游说代表拜会了财政部长。

collocations: partner with the association of banks
switch to the association of banks

words.enDefinition: a statement concerning capital surplus

examples.en: The annual report adds a statement of capital surplus after the revaluation.
examples.zh: 重估之后，年报增列了一张「资本盈余计算表」。

examples.en: Read the statement of capital surplus to trace the share premium.
examples.zh: 从「资本盈余计算表」可以追溯股本溢价的来龙去脉。

collocations: underwrite the statement of capital surplus
syndicate the statement of capital surplus
refinance the statement of capital surplus

words.enDefinition: a statement concerning partner's capitals

examples.en: The tax preparer requests a statement of partner's capitals every January.
examples.zh: 每年一月，报税师都会索要「合伙人的资本表」。

examples.en: Withdrawals appear as decreases on the statement of partner's capitals.
examples.zh: 业主提款在「合伙人的资本表」上列为权益减少。

collocations: underwrite the statement of partner's capitals
syndicate the statement of partner's capitals
refinance the statement of partner's capitals

words.enDefinition: ownership interest related to statement of owner's

examples.en: The statement of owner's equity reconciles profits, drawings, and fresh capital.
examples.zh: 「所有者权益变动表」对利润、提款和新增资本做了勾稽。

examples.en: Review the statement of owner's equity before pricing the buyout offer.
examples.zh: 在为收购出价之前，先审阅一遍「所有者权益变动表」。

collocations: model the statement of owner's equity
stress-test the statement of owner's equity
hedge the statement of owner's equity

words.enDefinition: statement of funds used in professional practice

examples.en: The treasurer circulates a statement of funds before every board meeting.
examples.zh: 每次董事会之前，司库都会传阅「基金表」。

examples.en: Donors study the statement of funds to see where the gifts landed.
examples.zh: 捐赠人研究「基金表」，了解善款的具体去向。

words.enDefinition: a state-owned reserve bank

examples.en: The State Reserve Bank holds the strategic grain and fuel stocks.
examples.zh: 「国家储备银行」保管着战略粮储与燃料库存。

examples.en: Credits from the State Reserve Bank carried no interest during the reconstruction years.
examples.zh: 重建时期，「国家储备银行」的贷款免收利息。

collocations: bank with the state reserve bank

words.enDefinition: loans related to state

examples.en: State loans funded the rural grid extension at a three percent rate.
examples.zh: 「国家贷款」以3%的利率支持了农村电网的延伸。

examples.en: Repayments on the state loans begin only after the first harvest.
examples.zh: 「国家贷款」的还款从首批收成之后才开始。

words.enDefinition: a state bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: The state bond for school construction pays a tax-free coupon twice yearly.
examples.zh: 为建校发行的「州政府债券」每半年付一次免税票息。

examples.en: Ratings agencies downgraded the state bond after the pension report went public.
examples.zh: 养老金报告公布之后，评级机构下调了「州政府债券」的评级。

words.enDefinition: in the United States, a bank chartered by a state banking authority (state-chartered), not necessarily owned by the government

examples.en: A state bank answers to the state banking department, not to Washington.
examples.zh: 「州特许银行（美国）」接受州银行部门的监管，而不是听命于华盛顿。

examples.en: She chartered the state bank back in 1998 with two branches.
examples.zh: 1998年，她申设了这家「州特许银行（美国）」，下设两个网点。

words.enDefinition: a first lien bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: The first lien bond ranks ahead of every other claim on the tolls.
examples.zh: 在通行费的所有请求权之中，「第一留置权债券」位列最前。

examples.en: Utilities often issue a first lien bond secured by plant and revenues.
examples.zh: 公用事业公司常以厂房和收入作押，发行「第一留置权债券」。

words.enDefinition: a bond related to first mortgage

examples.en: The railway funded the mountain section with a first mortgage bond issue.
examples.zh: 铁路公司发行「第一抵押公司债」，为山区路段筹资。

examples.en: On default, holders of the first mortgage bond take over the terminal.
examples.zh: 一旦违约，「第一抵押公司债」的持有人将接管码头设施。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from at owner's

examples.en: Goods stored in the leaky cellar are kept at owner's risk.
examples.zh: 存放在漏雨地窖里的货物，「风险由货主负担」。

examples.en: The consignment note stamps every fragile crate at owner's risk.
examples.zh: 托运单上，每一件易碎货箱都盖着「风险由货主负担」的戳记。

words.enDefinition: an assumption of risk used in professional practice

examples.en: Signing the lease implies the tenant's assumption of risk for common-area accidents.
examples.zh: 签下租约，就意味着租户对公共区域事故「承担风险」。

examples.en: The insurer denied the claim, citing the clause on assumption of risk.
examples.zh: 保险公司引用「承担风险」条款，拒赔了这一单。

words.enDefinition: an assumed rate of interest used in professional practice

examples.en: Pension math hinges on an assumed rate of interest of four percent.
examples.zh: 养老金测算的关键在于4%的「假定利率」。

examples.en: Lower the assumed rate of interest, and the funding deficit balloons.
examples.zh: 「假定利率」一旦调低，资金缺口立刻膨胀。

collocations: calculate the assumed rate of interest
compare the assumed rate of interest
interpret the assumed rate of interest

words.enDefinition: a stamped bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: Each stamped bond carries a revenue stamp across its face.
examples.zh: 每张「盖印债券」的票面上都贴有印花税票。

examples.en: Collectors prize the stamped bond for its intact duty stamps.
examples.zh: 收藏家青睐「盖印债券」，因为它的印花保存完整。

words.zhGloss: 稳定性的短期资本流动
words.enDefinition: policy or market action aimed at calming short-term capital flows
acceptedZhAnswers: 稳定性的短期资本流动

examples.en: Stabilizing short-term capital movement buys dips and sells peaks, easing the swings.
examples.zh: 「稳定性的短期资本流动」低吸高抛，平抑了市场波动。

examples.en: Economists credit stabilizing short-term capital movement for the calm interbank rates.
examples.zh: 经济学家认为，同业利率的平稳要归功于「稳定性的短期资本流动」。

words.enDefinition: a assumed bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: The acquiring railway kept paying interest on each assumed bond.
examples.zh: 收购方铁路公司照付每一只「承担债券」的利息。

examples.en: Creditors accepted the assumed bond in exchange for the lease transfer.
examples.zh: 债权人接受了「承担债券」，以换取租赁权的转让。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from assume no

examples.en: The broker only arranges cover and must assume no risk itself.
examples.zh: 经纪人只负责安排承保，自身「不负任何风险」。

examples.en: By contract, the shipping line may assume no risk for quay delays.
examples.zh: 按合同约定，船公司对码头延误「不负任何风险」。

words.enDefinition: a deposit placed with a bank

examples.en: The deposit at bank shows a credit balance of eleven thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 「银行存款」显示贷方余额为一万一千元。

examples.en: Interest credited the deposit at bank on the first of each month.
examples.zh: 「银行存款」的利息在每月一日计入账户。

collocations: open an account at the deposit at bank
deal with the deposit at bank

words.enDefinition: classes of stock with different rights

examples.en: The charter spells out three stock classes with different voting rights.
examples.zh: 章程明确规定了投票权各不相同的「股票种类」。

examples.en: Founders keep control through supervoting stock classes reserved for themselves.
examples.zh: 创始人靠专属于自己的超级投票权「股票种类」保持对公司的控制。

words.enDefinition: certificates evidencing ownership of stock

examples.en: The vault still holds paper stock certificates from the 1970s offering.
examples.zh: 金库里仍保存着七十年代发行时留下的纸质「股票证书」。

examples.en: Sign the back of the stock certificates before lodging them for transfer.
examples.zh: 把「股票证书」送去过户之前，先在背面签字。

words.enDefinition: a book recording stock certificate

examples.en: The registrar logs every transfer in the stock certificate book.
examples.zh: 登记员把每一次转让都记入「股票簿」。

examples.en: A fresh stock certificate book opens whenever the old one fills up.
examples.zh: 旧册写满之后，就会启用新的「股票簿」。

words.enDefinition: a capitalization for stock

examples.en: The bonus issue completed the stock capitalization of the retained earnings.
examples.zh: 这次送股完成了留存收益的「股份资本化」。

examples.en: Stock capitalization turns profits into shares without touching the cash balance.
examples.zh: 「股份资本化」把利润变成股份，而不动用现金余额。

words.enDefinition: a stock broker used in professional practice

examples.en: Her stock broker called before the market opened with two trade ideas.
examples.zh: 开盘之前，「证券经纪人」打来电话，带来两个交易想法。

examples.en: Complaints against the stock broker go straight to the conduct committee.
examples.zh: 针对「证券经纪人」的投诉会直接递交纪律委员会。

words.enDefinition: averages of stock

examples.en: Newspapers once printed the stock averages beside the shipping lists.
examples.zh: 当年的报纸把「股票平均指数」印在航运消息旁边。

examples.en: Rising stock averages drew the whole street back into equities.
examples.zh: 「股票平均指数」走高，把整条街的资金又拉回了股市。

words.enDefinition: an assessment for stock

examples.en: The board levied a stock assessment to fund the new wing.
examples.zh: 董事会决定向股东征收一笔「摊派资本」，为新翼楼筹资。

examples.en: Members paid the stock assessment in three monthly installments this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天，成员分三期缴清了「摊派资本」。

words.enDefinition: arbitrage trading in stocks across markets

examples.en: Stock arbitrage between the two exchanges narrowed after the trading link launched.
examples.zh: 互联互通开通之后，两所之间的「股票套利」空间收窄了。

examples.en: His stock arbitrage playbook pairs the dual-listed shares every morning.
examples.zh: 他的「股票套利」手册每天早晨对双重上市的股票做配对分析。

words.enDefinition: an allotment for stock

examples.en: Her stock allotment in the IPO came to two hundred shares.
examples.zh: 这次IPO中，她的「股票配额」是两百股。

examples.en: Small applicants saw their stock allotment scaled down across the board.
examples.zh: 小额申购者的「股票配额」被一律按比例缩减。

words.enDefinition: a loan of securities (or cash loan secured by stock) arranged between parties, often for short selling or financing

examples.en: The desk borrows the shares through a stock loan with the pension fund.
examples.zh: 交易台通过与养老金基金的「股票贷借」借入这只股票。

examples.en: Fees on the stock loan decide the short seller's borrowing cost.
examples.zh: 「股票贷借」的费率决定了空头借贷的成本。

words.enDefinition: stock issued in exchange for property

examples.en: The founder recorded stock issued for property when the landlord accepted shares as rent.
examples.zh: 房东接受股份抵租，创始人据此记下了「发行股票换取财产」。

examples.en: Auditors value stock issued for property at the appraised land price.
examples.zh: 审计师按土地评估价给「发行股票换取财产」计价。

words.enDefinition: an issue of stock

examples.en: The stock issue of five million shares funded the second plant.
examples.zh: 这次五百万股的「股票发行」为第二座工厂筹足了资金。

examples.en: Regulators cleared the stock issue after two rounds of questions.
examples.zh: 经过两轮问询，监管机构批准了这次「股票发行」。

words.enDefinition: an issuance for stock

examples.en: The stock issuance priced at the bottom of the marketed range.
examples.zh: 这次「股票发行」按询价区间的下限定价。

examples.en: A secondary stock issuance followed within eighteen months of the IPO.
examples.zh: IPO之后十八个月，公司又完成了一次「股票发行」。

words.enDefinition: exchange-traded contracts related to stock

examples.en: Single-name stock futures expire on the third Friday of each month.
examples.zh: 单一股票的「股票期货」在每月第三个周五到期。

examples.en: She hedges her bonus shares with stock futures until vesting ends.
examples.zh: 在归属期结束之前，她用「股票期货」对冲奖金股的价格风险。

words.enDefinition: organised markets for trading stocks

examples.en: The merger would leave the region with two stock exchanges.
examples.zh: 合并之后，该地区将只剩两家「证券交易所」。

examples.en: Listing rules differ across the three stock exchanges under one regulator.
examples.zh: 在同一监管之下，三家「证券交易所」的上市规则各不相同。

collocations: clear goods through the stock exchanges

words.enDefinition: indices tracking stock exchange prices

examples.en: Broadcasters quote the stock exchange indices every fifteen minutes through the session.
examples.zh: 整个交易时段，广播每隔十五分钟播报一次「股票交易指数」。

examples.en: Her model blends several stock exchange indices into one sector signal.
examples.zh: 她的模型把几个「股票交易指数」合成一个行业信号。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to stock equity

examples.en: The fund's mandate limits stock equity securities to listed companies only.
examples.zh: 基金契约规定，「股权证券」仅限于上市公司。

examples.en: Accounting splits stock equity securities from debt holdings on the balance sheet.
examples.zh: 在会计处理上，「股权证券」与债务持仓在资产负债表中分开列示。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for stock equity

examples.en: Her pension steers a fifth of its assets into the stock equity fund.
examples.zh: 她的养老金把五分之一的资产配入了「股权基金」。

examples.en: The stock equity fund focuses on mid-cap industrials and utilities.
examples.zh: 这只「股权基金」主投中盘工业股和公用事业股。

words.enDefinition: securities lodged as collateral for a facility or obligation

examples.en: The bank requires stock deposit collateral of liquid blue chips only.
examples.zh: 银行要求「以证券作担保」的押品必须是流动性好的蓝筹股。

examples.en: Top up the stock deposit when the market value falls below sixty percent.
examples.zh: 市值跌破六成时，「以证券作担保」的押品必须补足。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to assessable

examples.en: Holders of assessable stock owed another ten dollars when the call came.
examples.zh: 催缴通知到来时，「可催缴的股票」持有人还须再缴十元。

examples.en: Assessable stock suits ventures that fund their expansion in stages.
examples.zh: 「可催缴的股票」适合分阶段注资的创业项目。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to assessable

examples.en: The trust deed bars assessable securities from the estate's portfolio.
examples.zh: 信托契约禁止把「可催缴的证券」纳入遗产组合。

examples.en: Directors voted to convert the assessable securities into fully paid shares.
examples.zh: 董事会表决把「可催缴的证券」转为已缴足的股份。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to assented

examples.en: Holders who lodged assented stock swapped old shares for new notes.
examples.zh: 交存「同意掉换股票」的持有人，把旧股换成了新票据。

examples.en: Only assented stock qualifies for the reorganization's preferential exchange terms.
examples.zh: 只有「同意掉换股票」才能享受重组的优先换股条件。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the assented type

examples.en: Assented bonds extended maturity by five years at the same coupon rate.
examples.zh: 「同意改变条款债券」把期限延长五年，票息保持不变。

examples.en: Trustees counted the assented bonds before filing the restructuring plan.
examples.zh: 提交重组方案之前，受托人先清点了「同意改变条款债券」。

words.enDefinition: the completion of payment or delivery for financial

examples.en: The divorce reached a financial settlement before the second hearing.
examples.zh: 二审之前，离婚案达成了「财务(财政)结算」。

examples.en: The derivatives cash out through financial settlement rather than physical delivery.
examples.zh: 这批衍生品以「财务(财政)结算」的现金方式了结，而非实物交割。

words.enDefinition: a government's or firm's receipts and payments

examples.en: The ministry publishes monthly statements of financial revenue and expenditure.
examples.zh: 部委每月公布「财务收支」报表。

examples.en: Auditors matched financial revenue and expenditure across all eleven bureaus.
examples.zh: 审计师逐项核对了十一个局委的「财务收支」。

words.enDefinition: a securities order that becomes executable once a specified stop price is reached

examples.en: She left a stop order five percent below Tuesday's closing price.
examples.zh: 她把「止损单」设在周二收盘价下方5%的位置。

examples.en: The stop order filled fast when the shares gapped down at the open.
examples.zh: 开盘跳空下跌时，「止损单」很快成交。

words.enDefinition: a savings bank organised with stockholder capital

examples.en: The stock saving bank pays depositors a share of annual profits.
examples.zh: 这家「股份储蓄银行」向储户分配年度利润。

examples.en: Neighbors opened accounts at the stock saving bank on the corner.
examples.zh: 街角那家「股份储蓄银行」的储户多是街坊邻居。

collocations: partner with the stock saving bank
switch to the stock saving bank

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for stock redemption

examples.en: The society builds a stock redemption fund to buy back retiring members' shares.
examples.zh: 合作社设立「收回股份基金」，购回退休社员的股份。

examples.en: Contributions to the stock redemption fund came from this year's surplus.
examples.zh: 「收回股份基金」的资金来自今年的盈余。

words.enDefinition: money available or allocated for stockholders'

examples.en: Stockholders' funds fell after the writedown on the overseas venture.
examples.zh: 海外项目减记之后，「股东资金」有所下降。

examples.en: The bank lends against stockholders' funds rather than book profits.
examples.zh: 银行授信看的是「股东资金」，而不是账面利润。

words.enDefinition: a quotation for stock

examples.en: The evening paper prints yesterday's stock quotation on page nine.
examples.zh: 晚报把昨天的「股票行情表」印在第九版。

examples.en: Clerks copied the stock quotation onto the blackboard each morning.
examples.zh: 每天早晨，职员把「股票行情表」抄到黑板上。

words.enDefinition: power over stock

examples.en: The agent completed the stock power and had the signature guaranteed.
examples.zh: 代理员填妥「股票转让授权书」，并办理了签字担保。

examples.en: Attach a stock power whenever you mail the certificates for transfer.
examples.zh: 邮寄证书办理转让时，须随附一份「股票转让授权书」。

words.enDefinition: stock owned by an investor or entity

examples.en: His stock owned in the utility totals nine hundred shares.
examples.zh: 他在该公用事业公司名下「持有股票」九百股。

examples.en: The proxy count includes every stock owned as of the record date.
examples.zh: 委托书统计涵盖截至股权登记日的全部「持有股票」。

words.enDefinition: the total stock of physical capital in an economy at a point in time

examples.en: The war destroyed half the country's stock of real capital.
examples.zh: 战争摧毁了该国一半的「实际资本存量」。

examples.en: Investment adds to the stock of real capital only after depreciation is covered.
examples.zh: 只有补足折旧之后，投资才会真正增加「实际资本存量」。

collocations: calculate the stock of real capital
compare the stock of real capital
reduce the stock of real capital

words.enDefinition: exchange-traded contracts related to stock-index

examples.en: She hedges the portfolio with stock-index futures through earnings season.
examples.zh: 财报季期间，她用「股票指数期货」对冲组合风险。

examples.en: Stock-index futures traded at a discount after the tariff headlines.
examples.zh: 关税消息传出之后，「股票指数期货」转为贴水交易。

words.enDefinition: a certificate documenting stock trust

examples.en: Each stock trust certificate represents one unit of the underlying portfolio.
examples.zh: 每份「股份信托证券」代表底层组合的一个单位。

examples.en: The stock trust certificate names the custodian on its face.
examples.zh: 「股份信托证券」的票面上载明了托管人。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of stock

examples.en: The stock transfer between the two sisters settled on Monday.
examples.zh: 姐妹之间的「股票转让」于周一完成交割。

examples.en: Stamp duty applies to every stock transfer above the value threshold.
examples.zh: 超过价值门槛的「股票转让」都要缴纳印花税。

words.enDefinition: bearer shares transferable by delivery of the certificate (restricted in many jurisdictions)

examples.en: Stock to bearer passes by hand, with no register to update.
examples.zh: 「无记名股票」凭交付即可转让，无需变更登记。

examples.en: Regulators phased out stock to bearer to curb money laundering.
examples.zh: 为遏制洗钱，监管机构逐步取消了「无记名股票」。

words.zhGloss: 自动记录证券行市的收报机
words.enDefinition: a display or system that streams securities prices and trade data
acceptedZhAnswers: 自动记录证券行市的收报机

examples.en: The old stock ticker chattered out prices until the exchange closed.
examples.zh: 那台老式「自动记录证券行市的收报机」一直嗒嗒作响，直到交易所收盘。

examples.en: Museums keep a working stock ticker beside the telegraph exhibit.
examples.zh: 博物馆把一台仍能运转的「自动记录证券行市的收报机」摆在电报展品旁边。

words.enDefinition: an exchange contract related to stock

examples.en: The merger closed as a stock swap at one point nine shares.
examples.zh: 这桩合并以1.9股换1股的「股票交换」完成。

examples.en: A stock swap spared the founders any cash outlay at closing.
examples.zh: 采用「股票交换」，创始人在交割时无需支付任何现金。

words.enDefinition: the worth assigned to stock with par

examples.en: The charter authorizes only stock with par value of one dollar.
examples.zh: 章程只授权发行面值1元的「有票面价值的股票」。

examples.en: Issuing stock with par value below market protects the legal capital.
examples.zh: 以低于市价发行「有票面价值的股票」，有助于保全法定资本。

words.enDefinition: securities lodged with a party, usually as collateral

examples.en: The bank acknowledged the deposit of securities with a numbered receipt.
examples.zh: 银行开具编号收据，确认了这笔「证券寄存」。

examples.en: Collateral lodged as a deposit of securities stays in the client's name.
examples.zh: 作为「证券寄存」的担保品，仍登记在客户名下。

words.enDefinition: protection against loss related to deposit

examples.en: Deposit insurance covers balances up to two hundred and fifty thousand.
examples.zh: 「存款保险」为最高二十五万元的余额提供保障。

examples.en: The bank failed, and deposit insurance paid every retail saver within a week.
examples.zh: 银行倒闭之后，「存款保险」在一周内向所有零售储户完成兑付。

words.enDefinition: funds deposited in a bank

examples.en: The deposit in bank earns just under three percent on the sweep.
examples.zh: 自动转存账户里的「银行存款」利率略低于3%。

examples.en: Reconcile the deposit in bank against the passbook every month.
examples.zh: 每月把「银行存款」与存折核对一次。

collocations: bank with the deposit in bank

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from statutory

examples.en: Insurers list government bonds among the approved statutory investment options.
examples.zh: 保险公司把国债列入核准的「法定投资」范围。

examples.en: The statutory investment rules cap exposure to any single issuer.
examples.zh: 「法定投资」规则对单一发行人的敞口设定了上限。

words.enDefinition: money available or allocated for sterilized

examples.en: Sterilized funds sit untouched until the legislature votes for release.
examples.zh: 「封存基金」原封不动，直到议会表决解冻。

examples.en: The treasury parks windfall revenue in sterilized funds against emergencies.
examples.zh: 财政部把意外收入存入「封存基金」，以备急用。

words.enDefinition: deposit intended for bond redemption

examples.en: Each month the utility wires a deposit for bond redemption to the trustee.
examples.zh: 公用事业公司每月向受托人汇入一笔「偿还债券存款」。

examples.en: The deposit for bond redemption must clear before the sinking fund call date.
examples.zh: 「偿还债券存款」须在偿债基金催缴日之前到账。

words.enDefinition: a slip used to correct a deposit entry

examples.en: Clerks issued a deposit correction slip after the two accounts were mixed up.
examples.zh: 两个账户串户之后，柜员开出了「银行存款更正单」。

examples.en: Every deposit correction slip needs a supervisor's countersignature before filing.
examples.zh: 「银行存款更正单」须经主管副签之后方可归档。

words.enDefinition: a certificate documenting deposit

examples.en: Bring the deposit certificate when withdrawing before the maturity date.
examples.zh: 提前支取时请带上「银行存款单」。

examples.en: The bank reissued the deposit certificate after the original was lost.
examples.zh: 原件遗失之后，银行补发了「银行存款单」。

words.enDefinition: a bank that accepts customer deposits

examples.en: Our deposit bank clears the payroll on the twenty-fifth of each month.
examples.zh: 我们的「存款银行」在每月二十五日清算工资款。

examples.en: Switch the deposit bank if the quarterly fees keep rising.
examples.zh: 如果季度费用持续上涨，就更换「存款银行」。

words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to financing of instalment

examples.en: The manufacturer supports financing of instalment sales through its captive credit arm.
examples.zh: 厂商通过旗下信贷部门安排「提供分期销售的资金」。

examples.en: Financing of instalment sales turns hesitant showroom browsers into committed buyers.
examples.zh: 「提供分期销售的资金」把展厅里的观望者变成了买家。

words.enDefinition: a financing concerning exports

examples.en: The agency backs financing of exports with insured credit lines.
examples.zh: 该机构以受保信贷额度支持「提供出口资金」。

examples.en: Cheap financing of exports helped the machinery maker win the tender.
examples.zh: 借助优惠的「提供出口资金」，这家机械厂赢得了标案。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of financing

examples.en: The arranger charges a financing commission of one and a quarter percent.
examples.zh: 安排行收取1.25%的「筹措资金手续费」。

examples.en: Ask whether the financing commission already covers the guarantee fee.
examples.zh: 问清楚「筹措资金手续费」是否已经包含担保费。

words.enDefinition: an asset currency used in professional practice

examples.en: Economists once debated whether bank notes counted as true asset currency.
examples.zh: 经济学家曾争论银行券是否属于真正的「资产货币」。

examples.en: Under the gold standard, coin served as the economy's asset currency.
examples.zh: 金本位之下，铸币就是经济中的「资产货币」。

words.enDefinition: a unit of ownership related to assessment

examples.en: Holders of assessment share can be called for more than the par value.
examples.zh: 「有票面外责任的股票」的持有人可能被要求超额缴款。

examples.en: Mining ventures of that era issued assessment share to fund new shafts.
examples.zh: 那个年代的矿业公司发行「有票面外责任的股票」，为新矿井筹资。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to sterling

examples.en: The income fund holds sterling securities across gilts and corporate bonds.
examples.zh: 这只收益基金持有的「英镑证券」涵盖金边债券和公司债。

examples.en: Overseas buyers of sterling securities hedge currency through the forward market.
examples.zh: 「英镑证券」的海外买家通过远期市场对冲汇率。

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning sterling

examples.en: The branch extends sterling credit secured against prime London property.
examples.zh: 该分行以伦敦核心地段物业作押，发放「英镑贷款」。

examples.en: Sterling credit to exporters floats a margin over the base rate.
examples.zh: 给出口商的「英镑贷款」按基准利率加浮动利差计息。

words.enDefinition: bonds denominated in pounds sterling

examples.en: The utility refinanced its sterling bonds at a tighter spread.
examples.zh: 这家公用事业公司以更窄的利差，为「英镑债券」完成了再融资。

examples.en: Pension funds buy sterling bonds to match their pound liabilities.
examples.zh: 养老基金购买「英镑债券」，以匹配自身的英镑负债。

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to deposit

examples.en: The deposit rate on twelve-month fixed accounts rose to four percent.
examples.zh: 十二个月定期账户的「存款利率」升至4%。

examples.en: Banks compete on the deposit rate whenever funding turns scarce.
examples.zh: 资金一紧张，银行就在「存款利率」上比拼。

words.enDefinition: an extra amount paid for deposit

examples.en: The open cover starts with a deposit premium, adjusted at each renewal.
examples.zh: 预约保单以「预付保险费」起保，每次续转时再作调整。

examples.en: Any unearned deposit premium returns if you cancel within sixty days.
examples.zh: 若在六十天内退保，未到期的「预付保险费」将予以退还。

words.enDefinition: solicit for funds used in professional practice

examples.en: Charities may not solicit for funds without a registered collector present.
examples.zh: 没有注册募捐人在场，慈善机构不得「筹募基金」。

examples.en: The committee will solicit for funds at the spring fair again.
examples.zh: 委员会将在春季集市上再次「筹募基金」。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by floating

examples.en: The farm repaid the floating loan within the same season.
examples.zh: 农场在当季就还清了「流动贷款」。

examples.en: A floating loan of thirty days bridges the harvest income gap.
examples.zh: 三十天期的「流动贷款」弥补了收获之前的收入缺口。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the authorized type

examples.en: The treasurer may sell only authorized bonds under the 2020 resolution.
examples.zh: 依据2020年的决议，财务主管只能发行「核准发行的债券」。

examples.en: Authorized bonds total forty million, though only half have been sold.
examples.zh: 「核准发行的债券」总额为四千万，实际售出的只有一半。
